summary: Add scoped and auditable fleet standard-update ticket emission

delivery.outcome: Koru provides a bounded read-only, organization-scoped Wellmanifest freshness scan and explicit idempotent Planfile handoff emission without mutating adopter repositories. Excluded local, worktree, duplicate and out-of-scope checkouts remain available through a read-only inventory command.
nonGoals: Automatically adopt, commit, push, merge or delete any target repository
Refresh an untrusted or dirty standard source checkout
Replace target-owned Goal, CI or protected Validator delivery

architecture.decision: Add a local, fail-closed standard release observation, bounded parallel adopter inspection and serial Planfile handoff emission. Existing target repositories remain untouched; only their own governance workflow may perform adoption.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch; the scanner has no adopter-side mutation to undo.

validation.evidence: Governance and Ruff pass with zero errors.
Focused tests pass; full non-slow result is recorded in ticket README, with the three baseline failures reproduced on clean main.

commands: koru fleet standard-update WORKSPACE --standard-root CLEAN_STANDARD --format json
validation.evidence: Real read-only scan found 33 governed repositories: 2 current and 31 stale; dirty and linked-worktree state was reported without target mutation.
